name: session-improvement-loop
description: Research uncertain decisions and independently validate reusable improvements from task or session evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Research decisions and validate scoped skill improvements.
interface.longDescription: Portable research synthesis, independent skill improvement, and bounded session review. Reuses native agents and project evidence, preserves budget and authority, and loads Astra guidance only when relevant.
defaultPrompt: Research this decision using independent evidence and a shared budget.
Evaluate one evidence-backed improvement to this workflow.
Review recent sessions for reusable improvements.
